mekayis.metin: (فَقَسَ) الْفَاءُ وَالْقَافُ وَالسِّينُ. يَقُولُونَ: فَقَسَ: مَاتَ.

vikisozluk.baslik: فَقَسَ • (faqasa) I (non-past يَفْقِسُ (yafqisu), verbal noun فُقُوس (fuqūs))
anlam: to creep out of the egg
to pull down (someone) by the hair
to shoot, fire off a gun
to lose patience, to grow ill-tempered, to become vexed

vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin:
* From Aramaic פִיקֵּס (pīqqēs, “to remove the coils of blossoms on gourds”), from Ancient Greek ποκίζω (pokízō, “to shear, crop, prune”), from Ancient Greek πέκω (pékō, “to shear wool”).
* Related to Aramaic פַּקּוּעָא (paqqūʿā, “a type of gourd”), from Akkadian 𒉿𒅅𒄣𒋾 (peqqūtu, “colocynth, cucumber, gourd; vine-plant that spreads across the ground”).
